Specification: This module is a small TLC-oriented test specification that checks whether TLC reports an error when an operator is invoked with too many arguments. It defines a single Boolean state variable x, initializes it after printing a diagnostic message, and uses a trivial stuttering next-state relation. The spec also defines a simple unary operator Foo and an invariant Inv that incorrectly calls Foo with two arguments, making the primary purpose of the file a tooling/error-check test rather than a substantive distributed algorithm or protocol model.
FunctionApplication: Print("Should complain that operator Foo is called with too many arguments", TRUE)
StringLiterals: Should complain that operator Foo is called with too many arguments
